سللتما (form I)
# سَلَلْتُمَا (salaltumā) /sa.lal.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of سَلَّ (salla)
# سُلِلْتُمَا (suliltumā) /su.lil.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of سَلَّ (salla) and سُلَّ (sulla)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
